Sometime between [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] the [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|of the Renegade Squadron]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and some of the squadron's members were captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and sent to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] to be used as test subjects. Determined to save [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewie]] and the other [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] members, Han planed an '''escape''' from the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].
